description: Exact monetary operating costs derived from provider-exact metered tokens (Limitation #12 resolution)

token_statistics.source: provider usage records on N03c live grounded-generation rows

findings: Provider-exact token metering (p50: 1111 input, 221 output on n=58 calls) yields a per-turn generation cost of $0.000200 USD ($0.1995 per 1,000 pure generation turns). Under the evaluated tier mix (7.9% zero-LLM turns), the operating cost is $0.1720 USD per 1,000 turns. This tracks the remodelled $0.1682/1k estimate, confirming that retrieval context overhead (~1111 tokens) is offset by concise Bengali answer generation (~221 tokens).
